ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level ratio; approximately 80% high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels centrally distributed versus 20% low-intensity (black) pixels concentrated on margins and focal spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary high-intensity white field covering central lobes. Low-intensity black pigmentation forms a continuous band along the trailing edge and perimeter. Distinct cluster of approximately 6-8 low-intensity blobs localized in the lower-central region of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate internal angle of 40-50 degrees dividing the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the distal portions of both lobes. The left lobe tip is heavily jagged and eroded; the right lobe trailing edge shows frequent small-scale variations in pixel-amplitude.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature transitioning to a sharp downward sweep towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density cluster of raised, circular high-contrast pixel groups on the right distal tip corresponding to barnacle colonization.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on the right distal tip and margin. Significant morphological asymmetry with an elongated, tapered, and eroded left fluke tip.
other_distinctive_markers: The left lobe exhibits a significantly narrower 2D profile and more pronounced distal taper compared to the right lobe.
